Subject: SIG questionnaire & kickoff — availability + a few clarifying items

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for agreeing to help us run through the vendor SIG for Redwood. We're aiming to close our procurement loop by the end of the month and want to make the intake efficient. A few quick things up front:

- Attached is our starting questionnaire (Optix_SG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) — it's heavy on CAIQ sections we care about (data residency, logging, encryption, and third-party subprocurement).
- Our team would like a 45-min working session to walk the questionnaire, confirm what evidence you can provide, and surface any blockers.
- Preferred slots (PT): Wed 2026-07-08 10:00-10:45, Thu 2026-07-09 15:00-15:45. Can you confirm availability?

Top clarifying Qs up front so we can prep:
1) Do you have a per-customer data residency option, or is residency regionally routed only?
2) How granular are audit logs (user-level vs. request-level) and how long are they retained by default?
3) Do you permit read-only access to logs for customer auditors under NDA?

If it helps, we can share an example SIG mapping we've used with other vendors — happy to adapt.

Thanks,
Jason
Jason Reed
Security Lead, OptixAI

Hi Jason — thanks for sending this over and for the clear call windows.

We can do the Wed slot (2026-07-08 10:00 PT). I'll run the session and Marissa will cover evidence/controls; Dylan will speak to logging and retention details. Proposed working agenda (45 min):

1) 5m — Introductions & scope (SIG/CAIQ sections we will prioritize)
2) 20m — Walkthrough of your questionnaire (you call out the highest priority rows)
3) 10m — Evidence mapping: what we’ll provide during intake and what needs a follow-up (logs, architecture diagrams, config exports)
4) 5m — Next steps & owners (DocuSign, artifact upload, timeline)

Quick answers to your upfront Qs:
- Data residency: We offer region-based routing of inference and store customer artifacts in the region selected at onboarding; there is an additional Private deployment option if you require a fully dedicated VPC.
- Logs: We collect request-level and token-level telemetry; default retention is 90 days for hosted accounts, with retention-extensions available via Dedicated/Private options.
- Auditor access: We support read-only auditor exports under NDA; this requires a provisioning request and an approved access window.

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (2-page control map) — it has the high-level mappings that'll help during the call.

Let me know if Wed 10:00 PT works and who on your side will be on the call.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Meeting notes — Optix SIG session (2026-07-08) + Q&A transcript and actions

Folks — thanks for a productive session yesterday. Below are the notes, the brief Q&A transcript, and action items. I also uploaded artifacts to the shared Drive (link below).

Record of attendance:
- Jason Reed (OptixAI)
- Priya Kaur (OptixAI)
- Tom Wells (OptixAI)
- Priyom Das (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Dylan Brooks (Redwood)

Summary / Process map we covered:
- Intake: Optix sends prioritized CAIQ rows (they sent v1). Redwood annotates rows as: Provide artifact / Config export / Follow-up question.
- Evidence handoff: Artifacts uploaded to shared Drive folder and HubSpot link; large log exports via secure S3 share (pre-signed link) after NDA.
- Auditor access: Request -> Approval (security + customer success) -> Provisioning window (typ. 48–72 hours).

Q&A transcript (selected):
Q1 (Jason): Do logs include full request payload?
A1 (Dylan): By default we store request metadata and truncated payloads for PII protection. Full payload retention is available under Dedicated/Private deployments with explicit contract terms.

Q2 (Priya): For encryption-in-transit, do you support mTLS for private deployments?
A2 (Priyom/Marissa): TLS is used for hosted; mTLS is available as an option for Private deployments and for Dedicated with a customer-managed gateway. We'll include the config doc.

Q3 (Tom): What's the timeline for an auditor read-only export?
A3 (Priyom): Typical approval and provisioning is 48–72 hours after signed NDA and internal approval. We need requested time window and scope in advance.

Artifacts provided / links:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (uploaded)
- sample-anon-logs.csv (anonymized sample)
- architecture-diagram.png
Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOptixSIG
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-78321

Action items:
- Marissa: Finalize CAIQ row annotations and upload annotated workbook (Due: 2026-07-12)
- Dylan: Prepare anonymized log export README and sample (Due: 2026-07-10)
- Priyom: Draft auditor access playbook (approval checklist + timeline) and email to Optix (Due: 2026-07-11)
- Optix (Jason): Confirm if they want us to review/initial redline of their vendor security addendum via DocuSign (no deadline yet)

If any of the attendees want the transcript export or a 1:1 follow-up on any CAIQ rows, reply-all and we'll set it up.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
